summary.name: Cannery
summary.one_liner: Cannery is a self-hosted app for tracking firearm and ammunition inventory.
use_cases: track ammunition levels before and after range day
access ammo counts from any device
summary.what_it_does: Cannery is a firearm and ammunition tracker that lets users monitor their ammo levels before and after range trips. It can be self-hosted on your own server, or you can use an instance run by someone you trust. The page says data stays with the user. It is accessible from any internet-capable device. Cannery is free and open-source software under the AGPLv3 license. The listing on awesome-selfhosted also mentions Docker.
notable: Self-hosted, with the option to use a trusted third-party instance
caveats: The page gives few technical details; installation notes are linked but not included in the page text
